name: Walking Figure 4
instructions: Stand tall and take a slow step forward onto one foot.
Lift the free foot and place that ankle on the standing thigh, just above the knee, to make a figure-4. You may cradle the shin instead if that is more comfortable.
Stand tall, gently press the lifted knee down, and pause for a brief stretch in the hip and glute.
Release the leg, step forward, and repeat on the other side.
